about: Strength routine for the dashboard's Lifts tab. Coach-maintained; the athlete designed Long Life Lifts with the coach on Oct 21, 2026 and adopted it from the Patapsco recovery week. lift_routine: the routine; lift_block: its blocks in order; lift_ex: one row per slot (ex = the slot code shown on the page; id = the exercise in it, from coach/exercises.json; sets, lo-hi target range, unit reps or s, load: lb (total load), lb_added (weight added to bodyweight), band, bw; per_side; busy = kept in the 15 min busy-week version; step = the load step when every set reached hi; next_hard = what 'harder' means when load is not in lb); lift_phase: none (the athlete, Oct 21: no phase-in on the page; all lifts shown alike); lift_rule: the rules shown under the routine. the athlete's logged sets live in the dashboard store (lift_log/<date>) and are copied to coach/strength_log.csv by the morning run. Exercises rotate between training blocks only through coach/tools/lifts.py (coach/strength_rotation.json; the athlete accepts or keeps); every set is stored under the exercise id, so history follows the exercise, not the slot. legacy_ids on the routine row maps slot to exercise for lift_log documents saved before ids were recorded (before Oct 24, 2026).
